headline: Microsoft CEO Warns AI-Driven Bug Discovery Increases Risk of Tech Outages
summary: Microsoft Chief Executive Satya Nadella warned that AI tools are discovering cybersecurity vulnerabilities at a breakneck speed, requiring companies to create and deploy fixes instantaneously.
why: Microsoft Corporation is a major global technology software provider, operating critical enterprise software, cloud computing infrastructure, and cybersecurity platforms.

impacts.name: Microsoft Corporation
impacts.why: Microsoft's chief executive issued a warning regarding rapid AI bug discovery and increased potential for technical outages.
